title: Account Specialist, Homes

fails: Requires at least 2 years of experience; you have 0 years (student-run companies are not corporate experience).
questions: Hiring immediately; you are available from 2027-06. Will they hold the role until then?

reasons.love: Managing and growing a portfolio of vacation-rental partners is a commercial account role at a consumer platform.
reasons.good_at: F21 supports negotiation and partnership development, F10 supports e-commerce channel work, and F26 shows KPI reporting; direct vacation-rental portfolio experience is not evidenced.
reasons.needs: Agoda is a well-established regional travel platform, and the posting offers ownership of a partner portfolio.
reasons.paid: estimate, THB 35,000-55,000 per month -> about THB 45,000/month. Estimated gross monthly range for a Bangkok account specialist role requiring prior commercial experience; the posting states no salary.

summary: The account work fits his interests, but the required prior experience is the main eligibility barrier.
jd_text: Manage a portfolio of vacation-rental partners and grow their bookings on Agoda. Requirements: minimum 2 years of experience in business development, account management or sales; strong negotiation skills; fluent Thai and English; data-driven mindset. Full-time, Bangkok.
